name: Summer at AIS
description_short: Day camp for boys and girls at The Agnes Irwin School in Rosemont. Little Explorers (age 3 to rising kindergarten) do themed crafts, outdoor time and water play; Explorers (rising grades 1 to 7) explore STEAM, the arts, athletics and field trips on a rotating schedule.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel in writing before April 30 for a full refund including the $100 deposit; before May 31 for a refund less the deposit; no refunds for weeks cancelled or missed after June 1. Week changes depend on space.
notes: Explorers is full day only at $425 a week. Little Explorers is $300 a week half day (9:30 to 12:30) or $400 full day (9:30 to 3:30); campers must be at least 3 and fully potty trained. No camp Friday June 19 or Friday July 3, 2026; the page gives no price for those four day weeks. The school also runs athletics camps (rising K to 8), specialty camps (robotics, cooking) and academic enrichment, priced separately. Tuition assistance is offered to current AIS families only. Summer 2027 dates are not posted yet.
